name: performance-profiler
description: CPU profiling with flame graphs and kept artifacts (Node.js V8, Python cProfile/py-spy, Java JFR, Go pprof, .NET dotnet-trace), live attach to running processes, target-process memory and leak analysis (heap snapshot, tracemalloc and class-histogram diffs), microbenchmarks with confidence intervals and A/B significance, startup time-to-ready, HTTP load testing (open/closed model, thresholds, background jobs) with HAR flow replay, baselines with regression comparison, and Lighthouse / Core Web Vitals audits

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS
envVars.description: Set to "true" to allow load-testing / auditing private and loopback IP addresses (localhost by name is always allowed). Cloud metadata (169.254.0.0/16) stays blocked.

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_ALLOW_RAW_CODE
envVars.description: Set to "true" to allow benchmarking inline code snippets. Off by default because it executes what it is given.

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_OUTPUT_DIR
envVars.description: Where profiles, flame graphs, heap snapshots, run records and baselines are kept. Relative paths resolve against the server's working directory.

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_MAX_VUS
envVars.description: Hard cap on concurrent virtual users / requests in flight for load tests.

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_MAX_RATE
envVars.description: Hard cap on the arrival rate (iterations per second) of open-model load tests.

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_MAX_DURATION_S
envVars.description: Hard cap in seconds on load-test and profiling durations.

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_MAX_REQUESTS
envVars.description: Hard cap on the total number of HTTP requests in one load test.

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_SYNC_MAX_S
envVars.description: Runs expected to take longer than this many seconds start as background jobs (poll with get_job) unless background is set explicitly.

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_PYTHON
envVars.description: Path to the Python 3 interpreter to use (default: python3/python, or python/py -3 on Windows).

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_LIGHTHOUSE
envVars.description: Path to the Lighthouse CLI (cli/index.js or executable) when it is not installed in the project or globally.

envVars.name: PERF_PROFILER_CHROME
envVars.description: Path to a Chrome/Chromium/Edge executable for Web Vitals audits when it is not in a standard location.
